description: This file defines a report service module that handles API interactions related to weekly status reports, including creating, fetching, updating, deleting reports, and retrieving dashboard summaries.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new weekly status report by sending report data to the API.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches all reports for the current user with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific report by its ID.

methods.name: updateReport
methods.description: Updates an existing report identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteReport
methods.description: Deletes a report by its ID.

methods.name: getDashboardSummary
methods.description: Fetches dashboard metrics and recent activity data.
